title: NIM Chats
description: Browse the 200 most recently updated chats. Click a chat_id to load messages and annotations; click a message_id to view content and narrow annotations. Select All messages to return to all annotations for the chat. Dropdowns list up to 500 recent chats or messages. Browsing is independent of the dashboard time range. The latest 500 messages are shown chronologically; annotation details are limited to 1000 rows.

list.name: chat
list.label: Chat
list.query:
SELECT __text, __value FROM (
    SELECT 'All chats' AS __text, 'all' AS __value, 0 AS priority, NULL::timestamptz AS updated_at
    UNION ALL
    SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(LEFT(summary, 80), ''), 'Chat') || ' · ' || id::text, id::text, 1, updated_at
    FROM chats
) options
ORDER BY priority, updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 501
list.definition:

    SELECT 'All chats' AS __text, 'all' AS __value, 0 AS priority, NULL::timestamptz AS updated_at

ORDER BY priority, updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 501

list.name: message
list.label: Message
list.query:
SELECT __text, __value FROM (
    SELECT 'All messages' AS __text, 'all' AS __value, 0 AS priority, NULL::timestamptz AS updated_at
    UNION ALL
    SELECT m.role || ' · ' || m.id::text, m.id::text, 1, m.updated_at
    FROM messages m
    WHERE m.chat_id::text = ${chat:sqlstring}
) options
ORDER BY priority, updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 501

panels.title: Chats — click chat_id to drill down

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    c.id::text AS chat_id,
    c.summary,
    c.confidence,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m WHERE m.chat_id = c.id) AS messages,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message_annotations an
        JOIN messages m ON m.id = an.message_id WHERE m.chat_id = c.id) AS annotations,
    c.created_at,
    c.updated_at
FROM chats c
WHERE (${chat:sqlstring} = 'all' OR c.id::text = ${chat:sqlstring})
ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC
LIMIT 200

SELECT
    c.id::text AS chat_id,
    c.version,
    c.summary,
    c.confidence,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m WHERE m.chat_id = c.id) AS messages,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message_annotations an
        JOIN messages m ON m.id = an.message_id WHERE m.chat_id = c.id) AS annotations,
    c.created_at,
    c.updated_at
FROM chats c
WHERE c.id::text = ${chat:sqlstring}

panels.title: Messages — click message_id to drill down

targets.rawSql:
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        m.id::text AS message_id,
        m.parent_id::text AS parent_id,
        m.role,
        m.summary,
        m.content::text AS content,
        m.confidence,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message_annotations an WHERE an.message_id = m.id) AS annotations,
        m.created_at,
        m.updated_at
    FROM messages m
    WHERE m.chat_id::text = ${chat:sqlstring}
      AND (${message:sqlstring} = 'all' OR m.id::text = ${message:sqlstring})
    ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.id DESC
    LIMIT 500
) recent_messages
ORDER BY created_at, message_id

SELECT
    m.id::text AS message_id,
    m.chat_id::text AS chat_id,
    m.parent_id::text AS parent_id,
    m.version,
    m.role,
    m.summary,
    m.content::text AS content,
    m.confidence,
    m.created_at,
    m.updated_at
FROM messages m
WHERE m.chat_id::text = ${chat:sqlstring}
  AND m.id::text = ${message:sqlstring}

SELECT
    an.id::text AS annotation_id,
    m.id::text AS message_id,
    m.role,
    an.label,
    an.text,
    an.confidence,
    an.spans::text AS spans,
    an.created_at,
    an.updated_at
FROM messages m
JOIN message_annotations an ON an.message_id = m.id
WHERE m.chat_id::text = ${chat:sqlstring}
  AND (${message:sqlstring} = 'all' OR m.id::text = ${message:sqlstring})
ORDER BY an.created_at DESC, an.id DESC
LIMIT 1000
